name: Pirate Simulator! ☠️
desc:
Follow Tutorial at top of game screen to learn how to play the game! 

👍 ⭐ Don't forget to leave a THUMBS UP and a FAVORITE to support the development of this game! ⭐👍 

☠️Sail the seven seas collecting precious cargo, raiding other pirate ships with your friends, fighting in intense battles, raiding other players' bases and building up your own base in this thrilling game!☠️ 

🎮 Take the adventure home with an ALL NEW Pirate Simulator action figure! Available at selected stores and retailers. 🎮
